relations.subject: Vishnu Sitaram Sukthankar
relations.evidence: Sukthankar was educated at the Maratha High School and later at St. Xavier's College in Bombay.

relations.subject: Vishnu Sitaram Sukthankar
relations.evidence: studied mathematics during the years 1903–1906 at St. John's College, Cambridge and passing his Mathematical Tripos.

relations.subject: Vishnu Sitaram Sukthankar
relations.evidence: In 1909, he studied at the University of Edinburgh.

relations.subject: Vishnu Sitaram Sukthankar
relations.evidence: He completed a doctorate between 1911 and 1914 at the Humboldt University in Berlin under the supervision of Heinrich Lüders... he was formally awarded his degree only in 1921.

relations.subject: Vishnu Sitaram Sukthankar
relations.evidence: He completed a doctorate between 1911 and 1914 at the Humboldt University in Berlin under the supervision of Heinrich Lüders.

relations.subject: Vishnu Sitaram Sukthankar
relations.evidence: He was also a student of Hermann Jacobi.

relations.subject: Vishnu Sitaram Sukthankar
relations.role: Assistant Superintendent of the Western Circle
relations.evidence: In 1915, having returned to India, Sukthankar took up the post of Assistant Superintendent of the Western Circle in the Archaeological Survey of India. In 1919, he returned to Britain

relations.subject: Vishnu Sitaram Sukthankar
relations.role: General Editor of the Critical Edition of the Mahabharata
relations.evidence: In 1925, Sukthankar assumed the General Editorship of the Critical Edition of the Mahabharata at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute in Pune.
